sourceRefs.locator: IX.20, before and after the pact: the delegation goes from Metz to Guntram at Chalon, the treaty is reread and Fredegund’s embassies are discussed.
Discussion of Histories IX.20, pp. 162–163: Gregory’s embassy to Guntram in 588 and disagreements remaining after the 587 settlement.
Q203645, coordinate location (P625). Rounded to two decimal places.

summary.de: Gregor bezeichnet Chalon als den Ort, an dem er Guntram als Gesandter Childeberts antraf.
summary.en: Gregory names Chalon as the place where he found Guntram during the embassy on Childebert’s behalf.
